BrochureContent.Content:
Beautiful First-Floor Two-Bedroom Apartment in a Mature, Leafy Setting.
Nestled in a highly sought-after and established residential location, this bright and spacious first-floor two-bedroom apartment enjoys a wonderful outlook overlooking a charming public park, providing a peaceful green backdrop throughout the seasons.
Presented in excellent condition, the property offers well-proportioned accommodation with an abundance of space, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The apartment combines comfort and convenience in equal measure, making it an ideal choice for owner-occupiers.Please note we have not tested any apparatus, fixtures, fittings, or services. Interested parties must undertake their own investigation into the working order of these items. All measurements are approximate and photographs provided for guidance only.
Virtual viewings the 3D tour, will give you an idea of the features and layout of the property but there is nothing like a physical in person viewing.

Situated on Church Road, this mature and leafy neighbourhood is renowned for its attractive surroundings and excellent amenities. Residents can enjoy pleasant walks through the nearby park while benefiting from the convenience of a commuter train station just a short stroll away, providing easy access to surrounding areas and the town centre.
With its desirable park-facing position, excellent condition, and superb transport links, this attractive apartment offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy relaxed living in a well-established and convenient location.
Athmore is on Church road close to train station
Strictly by appointment with Joe McDonnell.
